title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Hosea 10: the luxuriant vine and its altars, Samaria floating away like a twig, and the call to break up the fallow ground.

questions.text: What is Israel called in the opening verse, and what has he multiplied?
questions.explanation: The verse says Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit, and that according to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars.

answers.text: A fruitful olive tree, and he has multiplied his idols
A watered garden, and he has multiplied his feasts
A luxuriant vine, and he has multiplied his altars
A planted fig tree, and he has multiplied his priests

questions.text: What will the people say about their king, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will say, we have no king, for we do not fear Yahweh, and the king, what can he do for us.

answers.text: We have no king, for we do not fear Yahweh
Give us a king like the nations have
Our king will save us from the enemy
The king has carried away our silver

questions.text: What does this chapter say judgment springs up like?
questions.explanation: The verse says they make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants, and therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

answers.text: Like a fire in the stubble of the harvest
Like a spring that breaks out of the rock
Like a flood in the riverbeds of the hills
Like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field

questions.text: For what will the inhabitants of Samaria be in terror?
questions.explanation: The verse says the inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, and that its people will mourn over it.

answers.text: For the altars of Gilgal
For the calves of Beth Aven
For the sacred stones of Bethel
For the high places of Gibeah

questions.text: What are Samaria and her king compared with in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says Samaria and her king float away, like a twig on the water.

answers.text: Chaff before the wind
Smoke out of a chimney
A twig on the water
A shadow at evening

questions.text: What will they say to the mountains and to the hills?
questions.explanation: The verse says the high places of Aven will be destroyed, that thorn and thistle will come up on their altars, and that they will tell the mountains to cover them and the hills to fall on them.

answers.text: Cover us, and fall on us
Hide us, and shelter us
Hear us, and answer us
Open for us, and let us through

questions.text: What is Ephraim called in this chapter, and what will be put on her neck?
questions.explanation: The verse says Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, and that a yoke will be put on her beautiful neck.

answers.text: A young calf, and a bell will be hung on her neck
A strong ox, and a rope will be tied on her neck
A wild donkey, and a halter will be set on her neck
A trained heifer, and a yoke will be put on her neck

questions.text: What does this chapter tell them to sow and to break up?
questions.explanation: The verse says to sow in righteousness, reap according to kindness, and break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek Yahweh.

answers.text: Sow in the morning and break up the clods of the field
Sow in righteousness and break up your fallow ground
Sow with weeping and break down the high places
Sow among thorns and break open the storehouses

questions.text: Who is named as having destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle?
questions.explanation: The verse says all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle.

answers.text: Jareb
Jehu
Shalman
Jeroboam

questions.text: What does the last verse say will happen at daybreak?
questions.explanation: The verse says Bethel will do this to you because of your great wickedness, and that at daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

answers.text: The king of Israel will be destroyed
The gates of Samaria will be opened
The altars of Aven will be burned
The vine of Israel will be cut down
